concept: Full pillar parity, VOICE-FIRST. The form-first Flutter app becomes a voice-first co-teacher: a nearly-empty ivory home with one large saffron seal mic (VIDYA), then the 6 pillars hung off that spine. Reuses The Ledger — Ivory & Ink design system; no new visual language.

navigation.home: Pillar 02 VIDYA voice canvas (one large seal mic) + Pillar 01 tool register below the fold
navigation.notes: Not a flat 6-tab bar. Create is absorbed into the mic (speaking is creating). Parent hotline (03) reached from Home/roster, not a tab.

units.title: Voice stack + permissions
units.notes: Injectable service abstractions (lib/shared/voice/, not the plan's lib/shared/media/voice_capture_controller+tts_player — the VAD/state-machine controller is U-V3): AudioRecorderService (record 5.2.1 -> WAV 16kHz mono, normalised 0..1 amplitude stream, start/stop -> Recording{path,byteLength}, cancel discards) + AudioPlayerService (just_audio 0.9.46 -> Base64Mp3Source in-memory playback, decodeBase64Mp3 degrades to silence, cancel-before-next-speak). All 4 plugins resolved with NO substitution: record 5.2.1, just_audio 0.9.46, permission_handler 11.4.0, audio_session 0.1.25. Added path_provider 2.1.6 as the recorder's writable-temp-path companion (Directory.systemTemp is not app-writable on Android) — not a substitute. Manifest: RECORD_AUDIO + microphone uses-feature + INTERNET (was missing from the release manifest). iOS Info.plist NOT touched (Android-first, no iOS target). 23 tests with fakes; no real mic/audio in CI. VOICE CANNOT BE EXERCISED LIVE (no device mic; routes 401) — verified by code + unit test only. Runtime mic-permission request UI (permission_handler at first tap + Open-settings recovery) lands with U-V4/U-V5 per HANDOFF.md §8.

units.title: Backend repos + DTOs (STT / VIDYA / TTS / session / profile)
units.firebaseGated: partial (decode/guard testable now; live calls 401 until real auth)
units.notes: 5 repos over ApiClient + typed DTOs. Added ApiClient.postMultipart (STT) + mirrored it in FakeApiClient. Typed directive domain object U-V6 consumes: VidyaDirective{VidyaFlow flow, VidyaDirectiveParams params}; VidyaFlow is the closed enum guard (fromWire drops hallucinated flows -> no 404, mirrors web KNOWN_FLOWS); AssistantResponse.toDomain derives 0/1/2-3 guarded directives (plannedActions preferred, singular action fallback, capped 3). Verified contracts: STT multipart field `audio`+`expectedLanguage` -> {text,language}; TTS request field is `targetLang` (BCP-47), NOT `language` (task wrote it loosely); assistant uiLanguage wins over detectedLanguage; profile POST is strict {profile:{...}} envelope; session POST {sessionId,messages,actionTriggered?,screenPath?,isNew?}. 47 tests via FakeApiClient (golden decode + request-shape pinning + a 401/429 branch per repo), NO network. Live calls 401 on the stub token until Firebase auth — EXPECTED, handled, verified by code + unit test only.

guardrails: scripts/token_guard.sh = PASS (tokens only; no raw hex/curves/radii)
existing suite green (771 tests at pillar-phase start; logic/widget/behavior unchanged) + each unit adds its own tests
golden tests re-baseline at 360dp + 800dp, light + dark, with Bengali/Tamil/Malayalam Indic probes, zero clipped matras at textScale 1.3 (all body text via AiText)
accessibility: every target >=48dp; WCAG AA contrast; Lucide-only, no emoji; teacher-dignity copy
Ledger reuse only: no new colors/curves/radii/widgets; saffron surface < 10% of any screen
motion budget: <=3 curves, <=420ms; every animation site checks context.motionEnabled and degrades to the final composed frame under reduce-motion
auth: Firebase ID token -> Authorization: Bearer -> server x-user-id; handle 401 / 403 PREMIUM_REQUIRED uniformly
branch from develop; one commit per unit; explicit git add paths; never push
